fi-pangasianodon-hypophthalmus.title: Iridescent Shark
fi-pangasianodon-hypophthalmus.summary: The iridescent shark catfish, Pangasionodon hypophthalmus, is a pangasiid catfish from the lower Mekong in Thailand, Laos, Cambodia and Vietnam. It also occurs in the Chao Phraya. The commonest…
rows: Schooling / social — keep a proper group
Omnivore. It's omnivorous , although a juvenile will require a good amount of protein in the diet in order for it to develop and grow at the correct rate.
Native to the lower Mekong river running through Thailand , Laos , Cambodia and Vietnam .
notes: Strictly speaking, decor isn't necessary for a tank containing an adult, provided the lighting is fairly dim.
You can however add some large chunks of bogwood , beech branches or smooth rocks if you wish.

fi-epalzeorhynchus-frenatus.title: Epalzeorhynchus frenatus
fi-epalzeorhynchus-frenatus.summary: The rainbow shark, Epalzeorhynchos frenatum, is a cyprinid reportedly native to Thailand, Laos and Cambodia. Recorded from the Mae Klong, Chao Phraya and Mekong basins, many of its wild populations…
rows: Primarily an aufwuchs grazer feeding on algae, small crustaceans, insect larvae, etc., and for it to develop its best colours and condition it should be offered regular meals of small live and frozen…
Reportedly native to Thailand , Laos and Cambodia and was once widespread particularly in Thailand where it's been recorded from the Mae Klong , Chao Phraya and Mekong river…
notes: Provided sufficient cover is available this species is relatively unfussy in terms of décor, and should not harm softer-leaved plants.
However it will thrive in a set-up designed to resemble a flowing river with a substrate of variably-sized rocks, gravel and some larger, water-worn boulders.

fi-myxocyprinus-asiaticus.title: Chinese High-fin Banded Shark
fi-myxocyprinus-asiaticus.summary: The Chinese sailfin sucker, Myxocyprinus asiaticus, is a catostomid endemic to the upper and middle Yangtze River system in China, including the Min. The only Asian member of its family, it is traded…
rows: Omnivore. A benthic omnivore with insects, crustaceans, small molluscs , annelids , algae and other vegetable matter comprising the diet in nature.
Endemic to upper and middle sections of the Yangtze River system in China including its major tributary the Min River.

fi-ariopsis-seemanni.title: Blackfin Shark SA
fi-ariopsis-seemanni.summary: The Colombian shark catfish, Ariopsis seemanni, is an ariid catfish from river mouths along the Pacific coast of the Americas, from Mexico to Peru. Usually sold as a silvery 2 to 3 inch juvenile, it…
rows: Omnivore. Young specimens will take bloodworm and other small meaty foods, while larger fish appreciate earthworms, mussel, prawn and sinking tablets.
Widespread down the Pacific coastline of Central America and north-western South America .
notes: It needs plenty of open swimming space to allow it to cruise around.

A simple, but effective setup would consist of a river sand substrate decorated with some driftwood branches (you can use common beech if it's first dried and stripped of bark), or better still, mangrove roots.
